f3_program: observe(at("gathering.friends.count", "current"), 7, "count", source("7 friends"))
offset(at("gathering.participants.count", "current"), at("gathering.friends.count", "current"), 1, "count", source("Josh gets together with 7 friends"))
observe(at("gathering.per_participant_contribution.amount", "current"), 5, "dollar", source("Everyone including him puts 5 dollars into a pot"))

product_relation("pot.money.amount", at("gathering.participants.count", "current"), at("gathering.per_participant_contribution.amount", "current"), source("Everyone including him puts 5 dollars into a pot"))
percent_of("prize.first_place.amount", "pot.money.amount", 80, source("First place gets 80% of the money"))
difference_relation("prize.remaining.amount", "pot.money.amount", "prize.first_place.amount", source("Second and third place split the rest"))
sum_relation("prize.remaining.amount", "prize.second_place.amount", "prize.third_place.amount", source("Second and third place split the rest"))
same("prize.second_place.amount", "prize.third_place.amount", source("Second and third place split the rest"))
query("value", "prize.third_place.amount")
assumptions: Interpreted “Second and third place split the rest” as an equal split.

f3_program: observe(at("finjan.contractual_obligations.finjan_mobile_future_commitment", "less_than_1_year"), 650, "thousand_dollar", cell("Finjan Mobile future commitment", "Less Than 1 Year"))
observe(at("finjan.contractual_obligations.total", "total"), 7478, "thousand_dollar", cell("Total", "Total"))
query("percentage_ratio", at("finjan.contractual_obligations.finjan_mobile_future_commitment", "less_than_1_year"), at("finjan.contractual_obligations.total", "total"))

assumptions: The requested per-year value requires an unstated month-to-year conversion, which F3-v1 does not allow annotators to invent.

f3_program: collection("donna.cake.pieces", "cake_piece", "donna.cake", source("one piece"))
consume("party_guests_eat", "party.guests", at("donna.cake.pieces.count", "current"), fraction(at("donna.cake.pieces.count", "initial"), 1, 2), source("the guests ate half the cake"))

transfer("share_with_brothers", "donna", at("donna.cake.pieces.count", "current"), at("donna.brothers.cake_pieces.count", "current"), fraction(at("donna.cake.pieces.count", "current"), 1, 2), source("she shared half the leftovers with her brothers"))
consume("midnight_snack", "donna", at("donna.cake.pieces.count", "current"), 1, source("she ate one piece as a midnight snack"))
multiple(at("donna.cake.pieces.count", "after_midnight_snack"), event_field("midnight_snack", "quantity"), 2, source("Twice as many pieces as her snack were left"))
query("value", at("donna.cake.pieces.count", "initial"))
observe(at("finjan.contractual_obligations.operating_lease", "less_than_1_year"), 773, "thousand_dollar", cell("Operating Lease Obligations:", "Less Than 1 Year"))
observe(at("finjan.contractual_obligations.total", "total"), 7478, "thousand_dollar", cell("Total", "Total"))
query("percentage_ratio", at("finjan.contractual_obligations.operating_lease", "less_than_1_year"), at("finjan.contractual_obligations.total", "total"))
